title: Quantitative Methods — Foundations
description: L1 foundation: time value of money, interest rates, and NPV/IRR basics — the quantitative bedrock of CFA Level I.

skills.title: Time Value of Money
skills.description: Present value, future value, single cash flows, ordinary and due annuities, perpetuities. Basis for all valuation.

skills.title: Interest Rates and Compounding
skills.description: Nominal vs effective rates, compounding frequency, stated vs periodic rates.

skills.title: NPV and IRR Basics
skills.description: Discounting uneven cash flows, net present value, internal rate of return intuition.

source: CFA Institute Learning Outcome Statements (public LOS summaries) for Quantitative Methods — topic headings only, no curriculum text reproduced (cfainstitute.org).
